evidence.q2: 48 usable turns per cell per arm is the corpus maximum. Of those, only cells with ttft_present=48 carry a latency sample: rows-longrun-c (4 arms), longrun-v3, -v4, -v4-tools, -v5-tools, -v6-tools. rows-longrun-2026-10-26.jsonl has 48 turns/arm but 0 non-null ttft_ms.
evidence.q3: A single cell needs n>=60 (min_n_for(0.95)=60, 60*0.05=3>=TAIL_MIN). At 48 turns/arm 48*0.05=2.4<3 so it is unreachable by counting fixes; only pooling reps (3x48=144) or a >48-turn cell reaches it. No rows-*.jsonl on disk holds more than one rep.
